court: The European Court of Human Rights (Second Section)

holdings.text: Declares the application admissible as to the complaint under Articles 2 and 13 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text:
FOR THESE REASONS, THE COURT, UNANIMOUSLY,

1.  Declares the application admissible as to the complaint under Articles 2 and 13 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the application lodged within the six-month time-limit and not manifestly ill-founded, thus admissible for Articles 2 and 13 complaints.

holdings.text: Declares the application inadmissible as to the complaints under Articles 3, 14 and 17 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: 2.  Declares the application inadmissible as to the complaints under Articles 3, 14 and 17 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found the complaints under Articles 3, 14 and 17 manifestly ill-founded and thus inadmissible.

holdings.text: Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention under its substantive and procedural heads

anchor.surface_text: 3.  Holds that there has been a violation of Article 2 of the Convention under its substantive and procedural heads;

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court found that the use of lethal force was not absolutely necessary or proportionate and that the investigation was ineffective, violating Article 2 substantively and procedurally.

holdings.text: Holds that it is not necessary to examine separately the merits of the complaint under Article 13 of the Convention

anchor.surface_text: 4.  Holds that it is not necessary to examine separately the merits of the complaint under Article 13 of the Convention;

holdings.reasoning_summary: Given the findings under Article 2, the Court found no need to separately examine the Article 13 complaint.

holdings.text: Holds that the respondent State is to pay the applicant, within three months from the date on which the judgment becomes final in accordance with Article 44 § 2 of the Convention, the following amounts: EUR 65,000 for non-pecuniary damage and EUR 5,000 for costs and expenses, plus interest
holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court awarded just satisfaction for non-pecuniary damage and costs, rejecting pecuniary damage claims, with interest payable after three months.

holdings.text: Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction

anchor.surface_text: 6.  Dismisses the remainder of the applicant’s claim for just satisfaction.

holdings.reasoning_summary: The Court rejected the applicant's claim for pecuniary damages due to lack of causal link with the violation found.

outcome.relief_summary: Violation of Article 2 (substantive and procedural) found; awarded EUR 65,000 non-pecuniary damage and EUR 5,000 costs; remainder of just satisfaction claim dismissed; respondent State ordered to pay sums within three months plus default interest.
directions: Respondent State to take general measures including legislative amendments to regulate use of tear-gas grenades
Respondent State to take individual measures including effective criminal investigation supervised by Committee of Ministers to identify and punish those responsible
